stories.title: Ordering Food at a Restaurant
sentences: Waiter: Good evening! Welcome to our restaurant. How many people are with you today?
Priya: Good evening, just two of us, please.
Waiter: Right this way. Here are your menus. Can I get you something to drink first?
Priya: Yes, could we have two glasses of cold water and one lime soda?
Waiter: Of course. Have you decided what you would like to order?
Priya: We would like the paneer tikka and a plate of butter naan, please.
Waiter: Excellent choice. Would you like anything spicy or mild?
Priya: Medium spice would be perfect, thank you.
Waiter: Your order will be ready in about fifteen minutes.
Priya: That sounds great. Thank you for your help!

vocabulary.meaning: a list of food items available in a restaurant
vocabulary.example_sentence: She looked at the menu before ordering.

vocabulary.meaning: a request for food or items
vocabulary.example_sentence: He placed his order for lunch.

stories.title: Asking for Directions
sentences: Sameer: Excuse me, could you help me find the nearest bus station?
Anita: Sure! Go straight down this road and turn left at the second signal.
Sameer: Left at the second signal, got it. Is it far from here?
Anita: Not too far, it is about a ten-minute walk from this point.
Sameer: That is helpful. Will I see any landmarks along the way?
Anita: Yes, you will pass a large park and a small bakery just before the station.
Sameer: Perfect, that makes it easy to remember. Thank you so much for your help.
Anita: You are welcome. Have a safe trip!

vocabulary.meaning: a traffic light or sign giving instructions
vocabulary.example_sentence: Turn right after the next signal.

vocabulary.meaning: a notable object or feature that helps identify a location
vocabulary.example_sentence: The old clock tower is a famous landmark.
The staff were very helpful during our stay.

quiz.question_text: Where did Anita tell Sameer to turn left?

What does 'landmark' mean?
options: a notable feature that helps identify a location
quiz.correct_answer: a notable feature that helps identify a location

quiz.question_text: How did Sameer feel about Anita's directions?

stories.title: A Job Interview Chat
sentences: Interviewer: Good morning! Please have a seat. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Kabir: Good morning. I recently completed my degree in computer science and enjoy building small apps.
Interviewer: That's great. What would you say is your biggest strength?
Kabir: I would say my ability to stay calm and solve problems under pressure.
Interviewer: Interesting. Can you share an example of that?
Kabir: During my final project, our server crashed the night before submission, and I fixed it within two hours.
Interviewer: Impressive. Why do you want to work with our company?
Kabir: I admire how your team focuses on learning and mentorship for new employees.
Interviewer: Thank you, Kabir. We will contact you soon with our decision.
Kabir: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

vocabulary.meaning: a good quality or ability someone has
vocabulary.example_sentence: Teamwork is one of her greatest strengths.

vocabulary.meaning: a feeling of stress caused by difficulties
guidance and support given by an experienced person
vocabulary.example_sentence: The company offers mentorship to new employees.

quiz.question_text: What did Kabir study?
Kabir said his biggest strength was public speaking.

What does 'pressure' mean in this context?
options: a feeling of stress caused by difficulties
quiz.correct_answer: a feeling of stress caused by difficulties

quiz.correct_answer: Its focus on learning and mentorship

stories.title: Catching Up with an Old Friend
sentences: Neha: Is that you, Farhan? I haven't seen you since school!
Farhan: Neha! Wow, it has been years! How have you been?
Neha: I'm doing well, working at a design studio downtown. What about you?
Farhan: I moved to the city for a job in marketing about a year ago.
Neha: That's wonderful. Do you still play the guitar like you used to?
Farhan: Actually, yes! I even joined a small band with some colleagues.
Neha: That's amazing. We should catch up properly over coffee sometime.
Farhan: Definitely. Let's exchange numbers and plan something this weekend.

vocabulary.meaning: the central or main area of a city
vocabulary.example_sentence: She works at an office downtown.
He went to lunch with his colleagues.

vocabulary.meaning: to give and receive something in return
vocabulary.example_sentence: They agreed to exchange contact details.

quiz.question_text: Where does Neha work?

stories.title: Checking into a Hotel
sentences: Receptionist: Good afternoon! Welcome to Sunrise Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?
Tara: Yes, I booked a room online under the name Tara Sharma.
Receptionist: Let me check. Yes, I see it here — a single room for three nights.
Tara: That's correct. Is breakfast included with the room?
Receptionist: Yes, breakfast is served from seven to ten in the morning.
Tara: Wonderful. Could I also request a room on a higher floor?
Receptionist: Certainly, I can give you a room on the fifth floor with a nice view.
Tara: That sounds perfect, thank you very much.
Receptionist: Here is your key card. Enjoy your stay with us!

vocabulary.meaning: an arrangement to have something kept for you
vocabulary.example_sentence: We made a reservation at the restaurant.

vocabulary.meaning: made part of something as a whole
vocabulary.example_sentence: Breakfast is included in the hotel package.

vocabulary.meaning: used to express agreement or confirmation
vocabulary.example_sentence: Certainly, I will help you with that.
